scripts.build: npm run build:remotes && npm run build -w @postal/shell
scripts.preview:remotes: concurrently -n auth,ship,po,track "npm run preview -w @postal/mfe-auth" "npm run preview -w @postal/mfe-shipments" "npm run preview -w @postal/mfe-post-offices" "npm run preview -w @postal/mfe-tracking"
scripts.dev: npm run build:remotes && concurrently -k -n remotes,shell "npm run preview:remotes" "npm run dev -w @postal/shell"
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -k -n remotes,shell "npm run preview:remotes" "npm run preview -w @postal/shell"
